changelog: Found by comparing the installed page against the design, screen by screen. The schedule now draws a now line across the day it falls on, which the design has and the page did not - without it a stored week is seven identical columns with nothing saying which part of it matters. The day view also opens on today rather than on Monday. Play order is the design's pair of buttons rather than a dropdown: there are two answers and both should be readable without opening anything. The picture gallery gets the room it needs instead of a 323-pixel slot under two cards that were holding height they were not using. And the proof-of-origin line read "Heldminted 37 min ago" - two words with no space between them.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
